import os, subprocess, sys, time, datetime, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/validation/scripts/transport')
import v7r2_cal_rate as vcr
sha = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
ts = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
token = f'R4B-{ts}-{sha[:8]}'
root = pathlib.Path('/workspace/validation/generated/r4b'); part = root / 'part'; part.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
kdir = '/workspace/.ionmc-cache/transport-samples/bf694e96/r4b-samples'
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='/workspace/src', IONMC_CACHE_DIR='/workspace/.ionmc-cache/ionmc-data', IONMC_REQUIRE_DATA='1', IONMC_SINGLE_PROCESS='1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1', OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', MKL_NUM_THREADS='1', NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS='1', PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1', PYTHONFAULTHANDLER='1', IONMC_RUN_SHA=sha, IONMC_RUN_SUITE='lv5d', IONMC_HOST_RUN_ID=token, IONMC_V7R_CAL_OUT=str(part), IONMC_V7R_KAPPA_DIR=kdir)
log = open(root / 'chain.log', 'a')
def say(msg):
    line = f'[{datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}] {msg}'
    print(line, flush=True); log.write(line + '\n'); log.flush()
say(f'token {token} sha {sha}')
say(f'kappa record imported from the chain run RUN-20261108T031543Z-b7a850c2 (same sha, suite lv5d): {kdir}')
cmd = [sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '--no-header', '-s', 'tests/ionmc/test_v7r2_calibration.py', '-m', 'calibration', '-k', 'test_v7r2_calibration_part and archive_fitted-part00']
say('RUN ' + ' '.join(cmd)); t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
log.write(p.stdout); log.write(p.stderr); log.flush()
(part / 'part.log').write_text(p.stdout + p.stderr)
say(f'EXIT {p.returncode} after {time.time() - t0:.1f} s')
if p.returncode != 0:
    print(p.stdout[-4000:]); print(p.stderr[-4000:]); sys.exit(p.returncode)
rec = part / 'v7r2-calibration-archive_fitted-p00.json'
if not rec.exists():
    print('part record missing'); sys.exit(4)
say('PART DONE')
print(vcr.token_line(token), flush=True)
for line in vcr.artifact_lines(rec, part / 'part.log'):
    print(line, flush=True)
